stops.name: Sölktäler
stops.detail: Far from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, the Sölktäler are the ideal place to rest and regain strength. Here there are no crowds, here there are not even cable cars, but lonely mountains, magnificent peaks and crystal clear water. Take a deep breath and enjoy the freshness of the air, experiencing the original beauty of this region. Finally vacation, finally arrive – finally rest.
